description: One-sixth sector: a central channel slice and two half outer channels, with three axial assemblies across the existing 2.97 m height. Coupled cycle-three workflow demonstrator.
moderator_margin_basis: Retain WR-1's 53.00068525425476 cm minimum outer-channel clearance at the initial pitch; the physical outer boundary remains vacuum.
power_basis: Retain the preceding 7.945946 MW full-core power and 2.97 m active height. Each of the 21 physical axial assemblies is now 990 mm tall; the sector represents seven full-core channels.

refueling.interval_policy: Optimize one common cycle duration for all rings. Start at 80 days; carry duration derivatives through all three cycles and evaluate the objective in cycle three.
refueling.transfer: At each common cycle boundary, insert one fresh assembly at the top and discharge the bottom assembly of every channel. Preserve the intervening inventories, identities and carried energies.
refueling.event_policy: All rings refuel together. No loading occurs inside a cycle.
refueling.equilibrium_check: Compare position-resolved inventories, burnup and power histories at equal cycle phases. Three cycles are the initial approximation; report residuals without extending the history automatically.

sampling_policy: Fresh restart: 1000 particles per batch, 80 inactive and 80 active batches, single seed 20301. Exploratory workflow precision; report k uncertainty separately from the nominal 1.002 constraint.
scope: Three native cycles from fresh fuel, with three 990 mm assemblies per channel. Differentiate diffusion, Bateman depletion, carried energy and refuelling through all three cycles; evaluate the objective in cycle three. Use one common period and zero boron. Reconstruct fuel macroscopic data from live isotope densities and physical microscopic responses. Three-cycle fuel replacement is not proof of equilibrium; report repeatability and sampling checks.
